description: This Java class defines a GUI menu bar for a table interface in the RomRaider project, including menus for file operations, editing, viewing, and comparing tables.

classes.name: TableMenuBar
classes.description: A menu bar class for managing table-related actions in the RomRaider GUI.

methods.name: initFileMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'File' menu with options like view graph and close table.

methods.name: initEditMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'Edit' menu with editing options, including conditional items for 3D tables.

methods.name: initViewMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'View' menu with table properties.

methods.name: initCompareMenu
methods.description: Initializes the 'Compare' menu with options for table comparison.

methods.name: initCompareGroup
methods.description: Sets up the button group for compare options.

methods.name: applyTableTypeRules
methods.description: Disables certain menu items if the table type is a switch.
